Unless the move was "blocked" for a different reason... like, the object can't move because... hmm, no, it's clearly blocked.

Let me test: select the 6×3 (W is currently on the 3×6; click the 6×3 at (44,31)), then click on the 6×3 frame in the top-left at (11,10). See what happens.
